# Edinformatics

> > Edinformatics provides K-12 STEM education resources aligned with NGSS and Common Core State Standards, plus comprehensive career guidance across healthcare, technology, and skilled trades.

The site combines interactive science and math activities (including molecular modeling with Jsmol, astronomy lessons on the Solar System, and physics simulations) with detailed career information covering job training, employment outlook, and earnings data. Educational content supports PARCC and Smarter Balanced Assessment preparation.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- Common Core State Standards (CCSS)
- PARCC and Smarter Balanced Assessment
- K-12 STEM Education
- Career Training and Job Outlook
- Solar System and Astronomy
- Molecular Modeling with Jsmol
- Healthcare Careers
- Physics and Density Activities
- Employment Statistics
- Apprenticeship Programs
- State Assessment Practice Tests
- Interactive Science Activities
- Professional Certification Paths
- Educational Technology

## K-12 STEM Education & NGSS Activities

- [K-12 STEM AND NGSS ACTIVITIES](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/k_12_stem_activities.htm): K-12 NGSS STEM activities: physics, density, Newton's laws with assessment
- [Gifted and Talented Math and Science](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/gt_mathsci.htm): Gifted STEM hub: MathMol, molecular modeling, physics activities
- [Mass Volume and Density](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/mass-volume-density.html): Interactive mass, volume & density activities with measurement tools
- [What is the geometry of the benzene molecule?](https://www.edinformatics.com/interactive_molecules/benzene.htm): Benzene C6H6 molecular structure: planar hexagon with Jsmol viewer
- [Digestive System -- How is food digested](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/digestive-system.html): Digestive system anatomy: organs, peristalsis, food breakdown process

## Astronomy & Solar System

- [Introduction to The Solar System](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/solar_system/introduction_solar_system.htm): Beginner astronomy: Sun, Earth, Moon, planets & space objects overview
- [The Sun - Reading and Assessment](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/solar_system/sun.htm): Sun facts: nuclear fusion, photosphere, solar wind with quiz

## State Assessment & Test Preparation

- [PARCC and Smarter Balance Assessment Practice Tests](https://www.edinformatics.com/testing/PARCC_Smater_Balanced_Assessment.html): PARCC & Smarter Balanced practice tests for Common Core State Standards
- [Math Practice State Tests](https://www.edinformatics.com/testing/math.htm): State math practice tests: NY, MA, MO, SC, VA released items

## Healthcare Careers

- [Careers as a respiratory therapist](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/respiratory_therapist.htm): Respiratory therapist career: cardiopulmonary care, licensing info
- [Careers as an optician](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/optician_dispensing.htm): Dispensing optician career: eyeglass fitting, contact lens training

## Professional & Technology Careers

- [Become a Lawyer](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/lawyer.htm): Lawyer career guide: law school, bar exam, employment statistics
- [Computer systems analyst](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/computer_systems_analyst.htm): Computer systems analyst career: MIS, IT job outlook & training
- [Actuary](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/actuary.htm): Actuary career: insurance industry, mathematics, certification paths

## Skilled Trades & Manufacturing Careers

- [Roofer](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/roofer.htm): Roofer career guide: training, employment outlook, apprenticeship info
- [Industrial Production Manager](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/industrial_production_manager.htm): Industrial production manager: manufacturing career training & outlook
- [Textile, apparel and furnishings occupations](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/textile_apparel_workers.htm): Textile & apparel careers: training, declining occupation outlook
- [Bookbinders](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/bookbinder.htm): Bookbinder & bindery workers: printing industry training & outlook

## Optional

- [Probation officer and correction treatment](https://www.edinformatics.com/careers/social_human_services_assistant.htm): Probation officer career: training, outlook, case management details
